async function call() {
	return "ok";
}
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

// CASE js_retry_backoff_multi expect=pass
async function withRetry() {
	for (let attempt = 0, delay = 200; attempt < 5; attempt++, delay *= 2) {
		try {
			return await call();
		} catch {
			await sleep(delay);
		}
	}
	throw new Error("gave up");
}
